lines.zh: 枯瘦的长腿，走在林子里
lines.en: Gaunt long legs walk the forest.
My antlers are wider than my head.
My steps make almost no sound.
Bark rasps as I pass.
I stand taller than the trees.
My arms are far too long.
Bones press against the skin.
A branch snaps when I move.
I walk the tree line.
No hurry; prey tires.
My prints stay in the soft earth.
The birds leave first.
Heat comes from my mouth.

lines.zh: 我走得不快，但不会走丢
lines.en: Not fast, but I never lose the trail.
A shape moves between the trunks.
I stand, and the forest goes silent.
My antlers snag a low branch.

lines.zh: 我立在枯枝间，听你的心跳。
lines.en: I stand among dead branches, hearing your heart.
I'm hungry, but not rushed.
Skin stretched over bone.
I'm reading the wind.
An animal scent, far off.
I lift a hand and a tree breaks.
Shields and armor mean nothing to me.
I almost never blink.
I wait for you to walk in.
My bones click when they move.
Did you hear that shriek?

lines.zh: 你的体温，在雪地上很显眼。
lines.en: Your body heat stands out on the snow.

lines.zh: 你在林间走，我的眼跟着。
lines.en: As you walk the woods, my eyes follow.
Don't turn around; I'm there too.
Your armor can't stop me.
My arms reach past your shield.
Only the two of us in these woods.
I've learned your gait.

lines.zh: 你走哪条路我都能跟上
lines.en: Whichever way you go, I follow.
I've waited long for this bite.
A crack ran through bone.
I roared, and the forest echoed.

lines.zh: 我的皮破了，里面没有血
lines.en: My skin split; there's no blood.
You struck me; good.
I've remembered your scent.
Pain makes me hungrier.
The smell of blood only sharpens my hunger.

lines.zh: 你以为砍中我了？我只是换口气。
lines.en: You think you cut me? I'm only catching my breath.
I don't eat things held out.
I want something living.
That meat isn't enough.

lines.zh: 你举着它，只是让我更饿
lines.en: Holding it only makes me hungrier.
I hunt for my own food.

lines.zh: 林子里的动物才是我的食
lines.en: The forest's animals are my food.

lines.zh: 放手吧，那东西救不了你
lines.en: Let it go; it won't save you.
I'm not picky, but I don't eat cooked.
You smell better.
Move it; don't wave it at me.
You hit bone.
You were shoved far back.
I'm steady as a tree.

lines.zh: 我的身体太瘦，很难撞准
lines.en: I'm too thin to hit squarely.
A trunk broke behind me.
You touched my hand; it's cold.
I needn't block.
Back off; don't come so close.
Hunger outranks that.
I've never seen my own kind.
That has nothing to do with me.
Don't you understand?
I only want to feed.
Don't come toward me.

lines.zh: 你身上还是活人的味道
lines.en: You still smell of the living.
Leave, while I'm still hungry.
Animal bones on the ground.
I pick them up with long hands.
Even these scraps count.
Bones break in my mouth.
There's still blood here.

lines.zh: 我俯身嗅了嗅，又直起身。
lines.en: I stoop to sniff, then straighten again.
I'll take what you drop too.

lines.zh: 你捡吧，我闻着你的味道。
lines.en: Pick it up—I can smell you either way.
That shriek wasn't wind.
I see the way you run.
My charge can't be blocked.
Shields are useless against me.

lines.zh: 我不需要力量，只需要到
lines.en: I don't need force, just arrival.
Your armor will split first.
One leap brings me to you.
I've been starving too long.
Don't stop.
Stop, and I'm there.

lines.zh: 我的鹿角，是从头皮里长出来的。
lines.en: These antlers grew out of my scalp.

lines.zh: 你在树间跑，我在树间走
lines.en: You run between trees; I walk.
Your breathing gives you away.
I heard the branch you broke.
You're running in circles.
I never feel fatigue.
Your boots sound louder.
Actually it's me getting closer.
That far cry was mine.
I stay at the edge of your sight.
My arms pass through the trees.
The forest calls for me.
A little more running and it ends.
One long-arm swing and you're airborne.
This blow went past your shield.
I pin you to a trunk.
An armor plate got peeled back.
This strike needs no strength.
You're thrown into the brush.
Two trunks broke.
I look down on you from above.
I'm awake.
The forest's first shriek.
Antlers emerge from the tree shadows.
I rise, and the treetops move.
These woods are mine to roam.
My footsteps arrive first.
Branches snap against me.
I need to feed, and to feed long.
Did you catch that sound?
That's me looking for you.
Slowly, I'm coming.
Fire caught my skin; I swatted it.
I fell, and my bones cracked.
Water is deeply unpleasant to me.

lines.zh: 爆炸把周围的树都掀了
lines.en: The blast tore up the nearby trees.
Something lodged in a bone gap.
This force blurs you from me.
Hunger makes me less than living.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，把林子照亮了
lines.en: Lightning lit the whole forest.

lines.zh: 脚下空了，我抓不住任何东西
lines.en: Nothing below; I grab at nothing.
